purpose: Test whether the bounded calculus syntax and rules admit a general typed semantic/model-theoretic interface beyond one finite model.
non_goals: declare calculus complete from fixture success

model_interface.model: M = <Proc, Res, Ctx, Dom, Rel, Adm, Cl, I>
model_interface.relations: typed relation interpretations with declared arity
model_interface.admissibility: Adm subset of Proc x Ctx
model_interface.closure: Cl subset of Proc x Res x Ctx
model_interface.interpretation: I maps well-typed terms to model-domain values and formulas to truth values or explicit undefined results

required_obligations: countermodel for each rejected general rule
inference soundness over every declared model class
promotion_gate: No canonical registration until independent semantic review, countermodel coverage, and a declared soundness/completeness result or explicit non-completeness boundary are recorded.
